channel.title: Medical Bulletins

item.title: Weekly vascular bulletin — September 21, 2026
item.description: Week of September 14–21, 2026. A slow week in the specialty press (Vascular News, Venous News, Endovascular Today and TCTMD published little of clinical substance) but an active one in the journals: almost everything…
